content:
Maria Hernandez: heads-up — saw negative per-invocation unit cost for tenant `acme-inc` during prefetch warmup. screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/warmup-odd2.png
Dave Kim: yuk. can you paste one example econ row so we can see emitted fields?
Maria Hernandez: quick sample from staging ingest: ```invocation_id=inv-2026-03-23-177 tenant=acme-inc model=rw-3b-quant tokens_total=488 tokens_cached=440 cache_credits_assigned=14 prefetch_amort_window=800```
Joanne Patel: that pattern screams double-crediting: ingest writes `cache_credits_assigned` and the console also applies a sampled_prefetch_credit when sampling_weight>1.
Dave Kim: short-term fix: skip UI sampling when `cache_credits_assigned` present. long-term: have ingest emit a canonical signal so UI doesn't have to guess.
Maria Hernandez: I vote telemetry-first. if ingest emits a single canonical field it's easier for support and for backfills.
Joanne Patel: propose adding two nullable strings to econ.v1_invocations: `prefetch_credit_origin` (values: "ingest"|"ui"|"router") and `prefetch_credit_bucket`. migration: null default for old rows. UI rule: if origin=="ingest" then do not apply client sampling.
Dave Kim: I'll implement a readonly preview endpoint `/econ/preview?tenant=...&prefetch_id=...` that returns the first N amortized steps (compressed), with a server-side TTL cache keyed by (tenant,prefetch_id). UI will show a small "show amortization" link in hovercard to fetch it.
Maria Hernandez: UX ask: keep default hovercard summary compact and only fetch preview on-demand so we don't blow up requests. also will prepare a short support blurb to explain negative-looking transient rows.
ops-bot: deploy queued: econometrics-ingest v3.5 -> staging at 1795001360 by @joanne :rocket:
Joanne Patel: will add fields + feature flag `econ_ui_sampling=false`, include migration notes and a small backfill for obvious prefetched rows. PR incoming.
Dave Kim: will add preview endpoint + tests to detect negative unit-cost regressions.
Maria Hernandez: thanks. plan sounds good — aim to patch to staging in next 48h and monitor econ dashboards. cc @product for visibility. :thumbsup:
